amendment_rule: P2 may change the surface only by editing this file and its test in the same PR, bumping /v1 when a key is removed or renamed

journeys.name_en: Open a new filing and inspect its largest supported changes
journeys.name_zh: 打开一份新财报并查看其中最大的受支持变化
journeys.gap: Largest is review-priority then recency, not magnitude; only the built detector set is supported.
journeys.p2_question: Should J1 rank by magnitude, or keep today's review-priority then recency order?

journeys.name_en: Open a displayed metric to its exact source occurrence or permitted document span and basis
journeys.name_zh: 从展示的指标打开到精确来源出现位置或允许的文档区间及其依据
journeys.gap: Disclosure receipts carry document spans; numeric findings and statements/compare cells link only to company-level EDGAR URLs or plain td values.
journeys.p2_question: Should statements and compare cells open an occurrence-level source span, or stay company-level EDGAR links?

journeys.name_en: Rewind the query cutoff to a historical answer or absence
journeys.name_zh: 将查询截止日回拨到历史答案或缺失
journeys.gap: Cutoff-aware financial query and addressable attested-history snapshots exist on the API; the page has no cutoff control and reads only /latest.
journeys.p2_question: Where does the cutoff or as-of control live, and how does the page show a historical absence?

journeys.name_en: Compare a valid peer cohort, see excluded peers, and recover the saved comparison
journeys.name_zh: 对比有效同业组、查看被排除同业并恢复已保存的对比
journeys.gap: No peer or cohort UI, no exclusion reasons, no saved-comparison store; the only shareable page state is ?symbol= for one company.
journeys.p2_question: Who owns peer-cohort membership, exclusion reasons, and saved-comparison persistence?

journeys.name_en: Export and refresh the same values, policies, and source references through API and Excel
journeys.name_zh: 通过 API 和 Excel 导出并刷新相同的数值、策略和来源引用
journeys.gap: State, health, attested-history, and financial POST APIs exist; the page has no export control, no Excel, and refresh is reload plus cache no-store.
journeys.p2_question: Where is the export entry point on this page, and does it cover API, Excel, or both?

panels.data_source: JS gate states plus template state_summary preview counts
first high/watch finding, coverage.metrics_pct, evidence counts
company().periods x METRICS keys as plain table cells
disclosure bundle tracks/comparison findings and evidence_receipts
comparison.redline_ops or redlines joined by accession and block_id
disclosure documents with accession and source_url
any two company().periods x METRICS cards
state source/detectors map plus GET attested-history latest/roots/detail
selected finding evidence/formula/threshold or disclosure receipts
attested-history root waterfall for the selected root_cell_id

first_viewport.desktop_1440: At 1440 the first viewport is narrative: site nav, hero promise, run-meta strip, company picker, then overview quick-signal and glance counts; ranked findings start at or just below the fold.
first_viewport.mobile_390: At 390 the first viewport is nav plus hero headline, deck, and promise chips; picker and quick-signal sit two to three screens down.

i18n.mechanism: Template macro t(en, zh) emits .l-en/.l-zh spans; JS pair(en, zh) and fieldPair(obj, stem) read stem_en/stem_zh.
